description:
## Finding
\`pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:18\` carries the canonical user-facing quick-start example for chain verification:

\`\`\`rust,ignore
use pkix_chain::{verify_chain, NoRevocation, ValidationPolicy, TrustAnchor};
let policy = ValidationPolicy::new(now_unix_timestamp);
let result = verify_chain(&chain, &anchors, &policy, &my_verifier, &NoRevocation)?;
\`\`\`

\`cargo test\` reports it as \`ignored\`. The workspace README presents an almost identical example as the recommended caller pattern.

## Why P1
The marquee documentation example for the umbrella crate is not even compile-checked. If the API surface drifts (rename, signature change), the README stays plausible-looking and the doctest never catches it. Both the crate-level doctest in pkix-composite (line 17) and pkix-profiles (line 29) are in the same shape.

## Fix
Convert \`rust,ignore\` to \`rust,no_run\` and provide synthetic \`now_unix_timestamp\`, \`chain\`, \`anchors\`, \`my_verifier\` bindings (e.g. \`unimplemented!()\` or fixture-loaded values gated behind \`# fn main() -> ... { ... }\` doctest scaffolding). The pkix-chain-simple doctest at line 425 already demonstrates the pattern: \`# let leaf_der: &[u8] = &[];\` etc.

## Scope reference
\`pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:18\`. (Same shape: \`pkix-composite/src/lib.rs:17\`, \`pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:29\`, \`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:316,690\` — those are addressed in a separate P3 issue.)
title: P1: pkix-chain crate-level doctest is rust,ignore — README example is workspace-public yet untested
